title: SolarTRACE AHJ residential solar permitting attributes

jurisdictions.description: One item per Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) the document gives information about.

ahj.title: AHJ Name
ahj.description: Jurisdiction name exactly as given in ROSTER CANDIDATES when present.

solsmart_awardee.title: SolSmart Awardee
solsmart_awardee.description: SolSmart designation level awarded to this AHJ, e.g. from a SolSmart community listing or designation announcement naming it. No only when a source says the AHJ is not designated; absence from a list is not No.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

online_permitting.title: Online Permitting
online_permitting.description: Yes when the AHJ accepts residential solar or building permit applications online (portal, e-permit system, or email). No only when a source says applications must be submitted in person or on paper.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

online_instant_permitting.title: Online Instant Permitting
online_instant_permitting.description: Automated instant permitting for standard residential PV. 'Yes (SolarAPP+)' when the AHJ accepts or uses SolarAPP+, or an official SolarAPP+ availability list or data export lists it; 'Yes (Symbium)' / 'Yes (Other)' for other automated platforms. No only when a source says the AHJ offers no instant permitting; absence from a list is not No.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

structural_stamp.title: Structural Stamp From Professional Engineer Required
structural_stamp.description: Whether residential rooftop PV needs a professional engineer's structural review: a stamped or sealed structural letter, an engineer's evaluation, or structural calculations. Always = required for every rooftop PV permit; Sometimes = required only in some cases or waivable (e.g. only for certain roofs, or waived under a standard procedure); Never only when a source says it is not required.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

electrical_stamp.title: Electrical Stamp From Licensed Electrician Required
electrical_stamp.description: Whether residential PV plans need the stamp, seal, or signature of a licensed electrician or electrical engineer. Always = required for every PV permit; Sometimes = only in some cases; Never only when a source says it is not required.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

third_party_permitting.title: Third-Party Permitting Available
third_party_permitting.description: Whether private third-party plan reviewers or inspectors (e.g. approved third-party agencies or private engineers performing reviews or inspections) may be used. Yes = allowed; Sometimes = only for some review or inspection types or circumstances; No only when a source says only AHJ staff may review or inspect. Permitting software or platforms such as SolarAPP+ are not third-party permitting.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

rough_in.title: Rough-In Inspection Required
rough_in.description: Whether residential PV requires a rough-in inspection (of a partially installed system, before final). Yes when such an inspection is required. No only when the quote is the AHJ's complete list of required PV inspections and it has no rough-in (e.g. final inspection only).

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

virtual_inspections.title: Virtual Inspections Available
virtual_inspections.description: Yes when the AHJ offers remote inspections for residential PV or building permits (live video, virtual, or photo/self-inspection documentation). No only when a source says they are not offered.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence, list, or table row from the document that states this fact for this AHJ (or lists this AHJ); not a document title, citation, or study finding, nor a statement about another place or a vendor. Null when value is null.

fire_review.title: Fire Review Required
fire_review.description: Whether residential PV permits need a separate fire department or fire marshal review. Yes = required; Not for Resi = fire review applies only to non-residential PV; No only when a source says residential PV needs no fire review.
